titulo: Four sticky notes into the drawer
caption:
Four sticky notes into the drawer

Five sticky notes, five tasks. Four went into the drawer for now, and the one left got finished.

One task in sight gets done in twenty minutes, and five in sight get started and abandoned.

For whoever keeps one task on the desk and puts the rest away.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and five sticky notes spread on the right: yellow, orange and light blue. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says do all five at once. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers just this one, and four of the notes disappear one by one while the last slides to the middle and a small sparkle appears on it. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...huh. it's done. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, one at a time.
